title: My Own Application
subtitle: The mentor has permission to become the student
sourceCredit: Anh Vu Sawyer · The Moth Radio Hour, “Live and Learn”

shot.title: Pointing toward the gates
shot.direction: A mentor directs students toward the distant gates while her folded application stays in her pocket.
shot.soundDirection: School bell fading into a decisive pen scratch.

illustration.direction: Wide school courtyard. The mentor stands naturally beside the student, her weight on one foot, one open hand directing him toward distant college gates. A folded application corner protrudes from her cardigan pocket. Warm morning light, modest purposeful gesture.

shot.title: A corner escapes
shot.direction: A folded corner slips out and flutters once.
shot.soundDirection: School bell fading into a decisive pen scratch.

illustration.direction: Same courtyard and people. The student bends slightly to pick up the escaped folded paper, then offers it at a believable hand height. The mentor turns toward him with mild surprise; neither stares at viewer. Both hands and the paper remain clearly connected.

beats.caption: Don’t wait for permission. Apply. Go.
beats.speaker: MENTOR

shot.title: Go, apply
shot.direction: Her encouragement to the student is practiced and sincere.
shot.soundDirection: School bell fading into a decisive pen scratch.

illustration.direction: Wide school courtyard. The mentor stands naturally beside the student, her weight on one foot, one open hand directing him toward distant college gates. A folded application corner protrudes from her cardigan pocket. Warm morning light, modest purposeful gesture.

beats.caption: Then what’s this in your pocket?
beats.speaker: STUDENT

shot.title: The student notices
shot.direction: The student picks up the page and offers it back.
shot.soundDirection: School bell fading into a decisive pen scratch.

illustration.direction: Same courtyard and people. The student bends slightly to pick up the escaped folded paper, then offers it at a believable hand height. The mentor turns toward him with mild surprise; neither stares at viewer. Both hands and the paper remain clearly connected.

beats.caption: Oh, that. That was a dream I kept for later.
beats.speaker: MENTOR

shot.title: A dream kept for later
shot.direction: She recognizes the paper and smooths its fold while admitting how long she has kept it.
shot.soundDirection: School bell fading into a decisive pen scratch.

illustration.direction: Both seated on the stone bench. The mentor looks down and smooths the worn fold of the application across her lap while the student sits beside her listening. Her shoulders soften; the gates remain distant, not triumphantly glowing.

beats.caption: You keep telling us to begin.
beats.speaker: STUDENT

shot.title: Her own advice returned
shot.direction: The student returns her own encouragement without a triumphant lecture.
shot.soundDirection: School bell fading into a decisive pen scratch.

illustration.direction: Same bench, shifted natural posture. The student leans slightly toward her and gently indicates the gate with an open palm, returning her advice without lecturing. She looks between his face and the application, considering rather than smiling instantly.

shot.title: The unfolded application
shot.direction: The paper opens fully, with space reserved for a name.
shot.soundDirection: School bell fading into a decisive pen scratch.

illustration.direction: The mentor at a small courtyard writing table, fully seated and grounded. One hand steadies the unfolded application and the other holds a pencil touching its blank signature area. Her face shows deliberate concentration; student stands quietly a pace behind. No readable marks.

beats.caption: All right. At sixty-four, I begin.
beats.speaker: MENTOR

shot.title: At sixty-four
shot.direction: She signs her name deliberately. Keep the exact stated age from the draft.
shot.soundDirection: School bell fading into a decisive pen scratch.

illustration.direction: The mentor at a small courtyard writing table, fully seated and grounded. One hand steadies the unfolded application and the other holds a pencil touching its blank signature area. Her face shows deliberate concentration; student stands quietly a pace behind. No readable marks.

shot.title: Her direction changes
shot.direction: She turns her own body toward the gates, taking the application with her.
shot.soundDirection: School bell fading into a decisive pen scratch.

illustration.direction: Wide courtyard departure. The mentor walks slowly toward the open college gate with the folded application held securely in one hand. Student remains near the bench, pleased but unobtrusive. Her silver hair, glasses and clothing remain unchanged; no makeover or graduation fantasy.

shot.title: Beginning is an action
shot.direction: The page and the direction of travel resolve into the final illustration.
shot.soundDirection: School bell fading into a decisive pen scratch.
